question: Which programs started on or after 2022-01-01? Show the agency id and program code.
reply:
```sql
SELECT agency_id, program_code 
FROM program 
WHERE starts_on >= '2022-01-01';
```

```sql-unbound
SELECT agency_id, program_code 
FROM program 
WHERE starts_on >= :start_date;
```
